title: Special Number
description: Recognises a two-digit special number by digit sum, a 7 digit, or divisibility by 7.

data.question: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints "Special Number" when its digits add to 7, either digit is 7, or the number is a multiple of 7, otherwise "Normal Number".

brief.summary: Recognises a two-digit special number by digit sum, a 7 digit, or divisibility by 7.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a two-digit number and prints "Special Number" when its digits add to 7, either digit is 7, or the number is a multiple of 7, otherwise "Normal Number".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It adds the first two characters as digits and also tests each character for 7 and the whole number for divisibility by 7.
